scenario.title: 入住、房間問題、升等
scenario.context: 飯店的對話充滿被動語態：房間已經打掃好了、早餐有包含、你被升等了。第 18 單元學過基本被動，這個單元加上 get + p.p. 和 has been done，讓被動用法更完整、更口語。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Yes, I have a reservation under Minz. Two nights.
lines.zh: 是的，我用 Minz 的名字訂房，兩晚。

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Great. Your room hasn't been cleaned yet, I'm afraid. It'll be ready in about thirty minutes.
lines.zh: 好的。很抱歉您的房間還沒打掃好，大概三十分鐘後好。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No problem. Can I leave my bag here?
lines.zh: 沒問題。我可以把行李寄放在這嗎？

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: Of course. And good news: you've been upgraded to a room with a harbor view.
lines.zh: 當然。還有好消息：您被升等到港景房了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oh wow, thank you! Is breakfast included?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.en: It is. It's served from 6:30 to 10 on the second floor. We'll also comp your parking since the room wasn't ready.
lines.zh: 有，早餐在二樓，6 點半到 10 點。因為房間還沒好，停車費我們也幫您免了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Honestly, it's pretty swanky. I got upgraded for free.
lines.zh: 說真的蠻高級的，我被免費升等了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Lucky! Last time I booked the cheapest place I could find, and it was a total dive.
lines.zh: 好幸運！我上次訂了能找到的最便宜的，結果超破。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: My towels never got changed, and my phone got stolen from the lobby.
lines.zh: 毛巾從來沒換過，我的手機還在大廳被偷。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Oh no. This place is so ritzy they probably have a guard for the lobby plants.
lines.zh: 天啊。這裡高級到大廳的植物可能都有警衛看守。

patterns.en: Could I get a late check-out?
Can I leave my bags here?
patterns.zh: 我可以把行李寄放在這嗎？

patterns.en: Could I get some extra towels?
patterns.zh: 可以多給我幾條毛巾嗎？

patterns.en: Is there somewhere I can store my luggage?
patterns.zh: 有地方可以寄放行李嗎？

chinglish.right: My room wasn't cleaned. / My room hasn't been cleaned.
chinglish.why: 房間是被打掃的，要用被動。中文「房間沒打掃」省略了「被」。
被動要 be + p.p.，include 要變成 included。

chinglish.right: Can I leave my luggage here? / Can you store my bags?
chinglish.why: 「寄放行李」直翻 deposit 是存款的意思。說 leave / store。

chinglish.wrong: The room is very dirty dirty.
chinglish.right: The room is pretty dirty. There's hair in the bathroom.
chinglish.why: 英文不疊字；客訴時具體描述問題，比形容詞強調更有效。

grammar.title: 被動進階：get + p.p.／has been done
grammar.oneLiner: get + p.p. 是口語的被動，常用在「發生在某人身上」的事；has been + p.p. 是現在完成式的被動。
whenToUse: 現在完成被動：has / have been + p.p.。Your room has been cleaned. / You've been upgraded.
否定和問句：It hasn't been cleaned yet. / Has it been fixed?
get + p.p.：口語被動，常用在意外、改變、突發事件。My phone got stolen. / I got upgraded. / He got fired.
get + p.p. 也用在「變成某狀態」：get married, get dressed, get lost。
進行式被動：is being + p.p.。Your room is being cleaned right now.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 第 18 單元已經提過，中文很少用「被」，所以台灣人常忘了用被動。進入 B2 之後，還得分清楚時態：「已經打掃好了」是 has been cleaned，「正在打掃」是 is being cleaned。get + p.p. 則是母語者口語中非常常見、但教科書很少教的被動形式。

examples.note: 現在完成被動要有 been。

examples.correct: My wallet got stolen on the train.
We got upgraded to a suite!
examples.note: 口語好消息也常用 get + p.p.。

examples.correct: The pool is being repaired this week.

quiz.question: Your room ___ yet.
quiz.explanation: 現在完成被動：hasn't been + p.p.。

quiz.question: My luggage got ___ (lose) on the way to Tokyo.
The elevator ___ right now, so please use the stairs.
quiz.explanation: 正在修用 is being repaired。

quiz.question: Good news! You've ___ upgraded to a sea-view room.

slang.usage: 動詞 comp something = 免費提供；形容詞 It's comped. 飯店、餐廳、賭場常用。

examples.en: The manager comped our dessert because of the wait.
examples.zh: 因為等太久，經理招待我們甜點。

slang.meaning: 破舊廉價的店（通常是酒吧、餐廳、旅館）
slang.usage: a dive bar = 老舊但有個性的便宜酒吧，有時是帶著喜愛的說法。

risk.note: 當著老闆的面別說；但 dive bar 在朋友間常是正面的。

examples.en: The hostel was a dive, but the location was perfect.
examples.zh: 那間青旅很破，但地點完美。

examples.en: Let's go to that dive bar near the station. The drinks are cheap.
examples.zh: 去車站附近那間小破酒吧吧，酒很便宜。

slang.usage: 形容飯店、餐廳、派對很豪華時髦。

examples.en: They had their wedding at a swanky hotel in Xinyi.
examples.zh: 他們在信義區一間高級飯店辦婚禮。

examples.en: Swanky place! Did you win the lottery?
examples.zh: 好高級的地方！你中樂透了嗎？

slang.usage: 源自麗池酒店（The Ritz），形容很貴很豪華的地方。

risk.note: 有點老派但仍常見，帶點調侃。

examples.en: It's a ritzy neighborhood. Rent is crazy.
examples.zh: 那是很貴氣的街區，房租超誇張。

examples.en: I felt underdressed at that ritzy restaurant.
examples.zh: 在那間高級餐廳我覺得自己穿太隨便。

review.question: Could you drop ___ at the hotel?
review.explanation: 複習第 41 單元：drop me off。

review.question: The hotel ___ we stayed at had a rooftop pool.
review.explanation: 複習第 40 單元：指物用 that。

review.question: Help ___ to anything in the minibar.
I'd rather ___ somewhere quiet.
review.explanation: 複習第 34 單元：would rather + 原形。

review.question: I ___ for my room for an hour!
review.explanation: 複習第 26 單元：完成進行式。

review.question: We had a ___ at the hotel party. (超好玩)
review.explanation: 複習第 10 單元：have a blast。
